snippet.title: Xenomire | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Xenomire is a dark sci-fi PvE extraction shooter where every expedition is a gamble.

Explore abandoned facilities, complete dangerous quests, fight mutated creatures, collect rare equipment, and extract before the threat becomes unstoppable.

Build your operative with different weapons, armor sets, and modules. Take greater risks for better rewards—but if you die, you lose everything collected during the expedition.
